{{Leo}}

Leo is the 9th month of the [[Gaian calendar]]. It contains 28 days (4 weeks) and corresponds to ISO weeks 33–36.

== Overview ==
===Etymology===
English ''Leo'' "lion" (Latin). Japanese: {{ill|獅子座|ja|Shishi-za}} “lion-constellation.”  
===Gaiad themes===
Weeks 33–36 (Days [[Leo 1]]–[[Leo 28]]):   

Native American stories cultivating in genocide. The genocide is contemplated and repented for in the month of [[Virgo]]  
===EVENTS===
* [[Leo 14]] — Alolalia  
* [[Leo 15]] — Ghost Festival
